summary: Rabbi Harari examines the approaches of the Gemara and Poskim regarding which wicks and oils may be used for Nerot Hanukkah. He outlines the views of Rav, Rabbi Yoshua ben Levi, Tosafot, Shulhan Arukh, Rama, Kolbo, and Maharal of Prague on olive oil and wax candles. He contrasts the reasons for candle lighting on Shabbat and Hanukkah, including flame quality and the miracle in the Bet HaMikdash.
